rules.title: Broker fee allocation: only the party who engaged the broker pays
rules.requirement: A licensed broker or salesperson may contract with either the tenant or the landlord, not both for the same deal. Any broker fee must be paid only by the party (landlord or tenant) who originally hired the broker.
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.effective_date_note: Amended text effective August 1, 2025 per 2025, 9, Sec. 136 as stated on the page.
rules.key_value: Broker fee paid only by the party who engaged the broker

parsed.doc_summary: Official text of G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD½ as amended effective Aug 1, 2025: brokers must be licensed, may represent only tenant or landlord, and any fee is paid only by the party who engaged the broker.
